title: No Language Data Left Behind: A Cross-Cultural Study of CJK Language Datasets in the Hugging Face Ecosystem

bias_targets.methodology: Quantitative and qualitative analysis of dataset availability, scale, task distribution, documentation quality, and licensing across English, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean datasets on the Hugging Face platform to evaluate cross-linguistic resource disparities.

Qualitative examination of domain preferences, resource development patterns, and culturally specific content (e.g., Japanese subcultural content, Chinese institutional benchmarks, Korean community-driven moderation) to evaluate how local cultural norms shape NLP datasets.
